description: Guided persona-driven analysis playbooks. Returns step-by-step instructions to follow IN ORDER (do not parallelize the tool calls it prescribes). Personas: audit (deep technical audit for React developers), sprint_check (under-200-word health check for engineering managers), ceo_briefing (jargon-free architecture briefing), investor_scorecard (6-category technical due diligence), dev_onboarding (progressive walkthrough for developers joining the project).
